verses.42:33: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارࣲ شَكُورٍ

meaning: The root ركد (rkd) primarily means to be still, motionless, or stationary, like water or wind. It can also describe a ship becoming still or aground, or a balance being in equilibrium.
